sub_sector.value: Regulated electric and natural gas utilities

industry_position.detail: Electric generation, transmission and distribution, plus natural gas distribution. Its Alaska utility generates and distributes hydroelectric power.

commodity_exposure.detail: Generates and delivers electricity and distributes natural gas to customers.

revenue_structure.detail: State utility commissions approve retail electric and natural gas rates.

energy_transition.detail: Its power supply includes hydroelectric, natural gas and biomass generation, along with purchased wind power.

notes: The pricing mix for wholesale energy sales is uncertain.
